typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFileNameToLoad as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ReportDate as string,
		Customer as string,
		TransactionType as string,
		Quantity as string,
		Notional as string,
		Strike as string,
		Type as string,
		Underlyer as string,
		Spot as string,
		Expiry as string,
		Trader as string,
		TraderName as string,
		Currency as string,
		UpdatedUser as string,
		UserFunction as string,
		ID_update_date as string,
		MO_Update_Date as string,
		Update_Time as string,
		Month as string,
		Year as string,
		Strategy as string,
		Portfolio as string,
		Comments as string,
		User as string,
		ExtAccount as string,
		SystemRecord as string,
		Customer_Type as string,
		Holding_ID as string,
		Original_ID as string,
		Trade_ID as string,
		QView_Type as string,
		Legal_Entity as string,
		Trade_Date as string,
		Settlement_Date as string,
		Buy_Sell as string,
		Trade_Price as string,
		SM_ID as string,
		P_C as string,
		A_E as string,
		Days_to_Expiry as string,
		FO_ID as string,
		MO_ID as string,
		Risk_Group as string,
		Changed_Type as string,
		Comment_Load_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Create_dt = currentTimestamp(),
		fileLoad = toString($sFileNameToLoad)) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of TraderName} = TraderName,
		{Copy of A E} = A_E,
		{Copy of User} = User,
		{Copy of Year} = Year,
		{Copy of Customer Type} = Customer_Type,
		{Copy of Underlyer} = Underlyer,
		{Copy of Comment Load Date} = Comment_Load_Date,
		{Copy of Spot} = Spot,
		{Copy of Portfolio} = Portfolio,
		{Copy of Settlement Date} = Settlement_Date,
		{Copy of Strike} = Strike,
		{Copy of SystemRecord} = SystemRecord,
		{Copy of Original ID} = Original_ID,
		{Copy of ExtAccount} = ExtAccount,
		{Copy of Type} = Type,
		{Copy of Expiry} = Expiry,
		{Copy of Trade ID} = Trade_ID,
		{Copy of Comments} = Comments,
		{Copy of Holding ID} = Holding_ID,
		{Copy of Trader} = Trader,
		{Copy of UserFunction} = UserFunction,
		{Copy of Strategy} = Strategy,
		{Copy of Trade Date} = Trade_Date,
		{Copy of FO ID} = FO_ID,
		{Copy of ReportDate} = ReportDate,
		{Copy of UpdatedUser} = UpdatedUser,
		{Copy of Legal Entity} = Legal_Entity,
		{Copy of Changed Type} = Changed_Type,
		{Copy of Notional} = Notional,
		{Copy of MO ID} = MO_ID,
		{Copy of Customer} = Customer,
		{Copy of TransactionType} = TransactionType,
		{Copy of ID_update_date} = ID_update_date,
		{Copy of Month} = Month,
		{Copy of Trade Price} = Trade_Price,
		{Copy of Buy Sell} = Buy_Sell,
		{Copy of P C} = P_C,
		{Copy of fileLoad} = fileLoad,
		{Copy of SM ID} = SM_ID,
		{Copy of Quantity} = Quantity,
		{Copy of Create_dt} = Create_dt,
		{Copy of Update_Time} = Update_Time,
		{Copy of Days to Expiry} = Days_to_Expiry,
		{Copy of Risk Group} = Risk_Group,
		{Copy of QView Type} = QView_Type,
		{Copy of MO_Update_Date} = MO_Update_Date,
		{Copy of Currency} = Currency) ~> DataConversion
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
DataConversion sink(input(
		Comment_Load_Date as string,
		TraderName as string,
		TransactionType as string,
		ID_update_date as string,
		User as string,
		Spot as string,
		Customer as string,
		A_E as string,
		Buy_Sell as string,
		Legal_Entity as string,
		ReportDate as string,
		Underlyer as string,
		Create_dt as string,
		Month as string,
		P_C as string,
		SM_ID as string,
		Currency as string,
		Holding_ID as string,
		Expiry as string,
		Trade_Price as string,
		ExtAccount as string,
		Trade_Date as string,
		Trader as string,
		Comments as string,
		Portfolio as string,
		Strike as string,
		Quantity as string,
		Days_to_Expiry as string,
		Trade_ID as string,
		FO_ID as string,
		Update_Time as string,
		Settlement_Date as string,
		Customer_Type as string,
		MO_Update_Date as string,
		Type as string,
		UpdatedUser as string,
		Year as string,
		UserFunction as string,
		Original_ID as string,
		Strategy as string,
		MO_ID as string,
		Risk_Group as string,
		QView_Type as string,
		Notional as string,
		Changed_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Comment_Load_Date = {Copy of Comment Load Date},
		TraderName = {Copy of TraderName},
		TransactionType = {Copy of TransactionType},
		ID_update_date = {Copy of ID_update_date},
		User = {Copy of User},
		Spot = {Copy of Spot},
		Customer = {Copy of Customer},
		A_E = {Copy of A E},
		Buy_Sell = {Copy of Buy Sell},
		Legal_Entity = {Copy of Legal Entity},
		ReportDate = {Copy of ReportDate},
		Underlyer = {Copy of Underlyer},
		Create_dt = {Copy of Create_dt},
		Month = {Copy of Month},
		P_C = {Copy of P C},
		SM_ID = {Copy of SM ID},
		Currency = {Copy of Currency},
		Holding_ID = {Copy of Holding ID},
		Expiry = {Copy of Expiry},

		Days_to_Expiry = {Copy of Days to Expiry},
		Trade_ID = {Copy of Trade ID},
		FO_ID = {Copy of FO ID},
		Update_Time = {Copy of Update_Time},
		Settlement_Date = {Copy of Settlement Date},
		Customer_Type = {Copy of Customer Type},
		MO_Update_Date = {Copy of MO_Update_Date},
		Type = {Copy of Type},
		UpdatedUser = {Copy of UpdatedUser},
		Year = {Copy of Year},
		UserFunction = {Copy of UserFunction},
		Original_ID = {Copy of Original ID},
		Strategy = {Copy of Strategy},
		MO_ID = {Copy of MO ID},
		Risk_Group = {Copy of Risk Group},
		QView_Type = {Copy of QView Type},
		Notional = {Copy of Notional},
		Changed_Type = {Copy of Changed Type}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
